abilities.name: Fluttering Hasode

_curatorNotes: icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b): gcsim kinu.go:53 sets ICDGroupChioriSkill on the Tamoto slash, whose table entry is a 114f reset window in which only the FIRST hit applies. Measured 3/4 applied, the same as standard gives — at a 216f interval every tick opens its own window either way, so this is authored on the GROUP and not on a moved count.

firstTickDelay 0.6 → 0.6833 (41f) (2026-09-17, T1.5): gcsim createDoll queues the first tick at skillDollStartDelay (36f) and skillDollAttack lands the slash skillDollAttackDelay (5f) later — the frames report's 60f from cast (19 + 41). Every marker had been 5f early.

duration 17.5 → 17 (2026-09-17, T1.5): the talent table (docs/curation/talents/chiori.json 'Tamoto Duration') is 17.0s at every level; gcsim's skillDollDuration is 17.5 with no stated source. The Zhongli-stele precedent: the datamined number for the bar. Five ticks either way (the fifth lands at spawn + 905f).

Tamoto interval slashes migrated to summons[0].effects[] (P3): gcsim skillDollAttackInterval=3.6s, skillDollStartDelay=0.6s firstTickDelay. ATK multiplier turretAtkScaling[9]=147.74% Geo at TalentLvl 10. DEF-scaling FlatDmg (turretDefScaling) not authored — schema's damage Effect carries one scaling only.

A1 Tailor-Made: post-skill window branches into Tapestry (press E again: force-swap + Seize the Moment coordinated attacks) or Tailoring (Geo infusion 5s). ↻ 2026-09-17 (T1.5): the Tailoring branch is the DEFAULT — gcsim activateA1Window fires a1Tailoring when the window lapses with no input — and is authored as an `infuse` on the A1 passive. Tapestry is not modelled.

[A7] Precise off-field-tick scaling (ATK 147.74% at talent 10) and the omitted DEF-scaling flat-damage layer (turretDefScaling) are already documented in the summon-migration curator note above; the schema's damage Effect carries one scaling only, which is why the DEF component is unauthored.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The E bar itself. There is no `hE` variant authored, so an `hE` token resolves to the base ability and the bar draws the tap's cast frames and the tap's `cooldownStartDelay` (19 vs the hold's 34) — the bar's width, the swap connector after it, and where the cooldown tail ends are all the wrong cast's numbers. A Chiori player writing hold-E and seeing tap spacing is the exact confusion this repairs. Category: approximation-disclosure.
abilities.description:
Dashes nimbly forward with silken steps. Once this dash ends, Chiori will summon the automaton doll "Tamoto" beside her and sweep her blade upward, dealing AoE Geo DMG to nearby opponents based on her ATK and DEF.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the dash direction.

Tamoto
· Will slash at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing AoE Geo DMG based on Chiori's ATK and DEF.
· While active, if there are nearby Geo Construct(s) or Geo Construct(s) are created nearby, an additional Tamoto will be summoned next to your active character. Only 1 additional Tamoto can be summoned in this manner, and its duration is independently counted.

variants.label: Hold

_curatorNotes: The hold's Tamoto — identical to the tap's but spawned at skillCDStarts[1] = 34f. A variant's summons REPLACE the base's, so without this entry the hold would inherit the tap's 19f spawn.

AUTHORED 2026-09-17 (T1.5). gcsim skill.go skillFrames[1] = InitAbilSlice(88) with Skill 44, Swap 87 (Walk 86 and LowPlunge 52 have no key here); the upward sweep lands at skillHitmarks[1] = 37 (Durability 25). ⚠️ Its cooldownStartDelay is 34 (skillCDStarts[1]) and AbilityVariant cannot carry one, so a hold's cooldown starts at the tap's 19f.

abilities.name: Hiyoku: Twin Blades
abilities.description: Twin blades leave their sheaths as Chiori slices with the clean cuts of a master tailor, dealing AoE Geo DMG based on her ATK and DEF.

variants.label: C2 Kinu

_curatorNotes: Authored 2026-09-19 (summon-conditions round) as a CONSTELLATION-GATED VARIANT of the burst: a variant's summons replace the base's and matchVariant is condition-aware, so the Kinu lane exists only at C2+ and C0 is byte-identical. gcsim cons.go c2() runs at the burst hitmark - 1 (91f): a 600f ticker spawns a Kinu every 180f, and each strikes skillDollStartDelay + skillDollAttackDelay = 41f after its spawn - hits at 312 / 492 / 672f from the cast, three per burst. The window is the 10s the kit states; interval 3s is the spawn cadence and firstTickDelay 3.6833 (221f) lands the first strike.

scaling 251.16 = 170% of the Tamoto slash (147.74) as the kit states. icdGate is ICDGroupChioriSkill (114f), the same group Tamoto carries; at a 180f interval every strike applies. gcsim shares that ONE counter between Tamoto and Kinu and ours are per series - counter sharing across entities is unmodelled.
The kit calls this Elemental Skill DMG; a tick inherits its host cast's class here, so these hits read as burst hits to an onHit consumer. No effect type can restate a tick's damage class.

Exists only to gate the Kinu summon on C2 (docs/summon-conditions-round.md). It states no frames, cooldown, application or effects, so every one of those falls through to the base burst. The frames audit cannot reach a plain-input variant (variantDumpKey returns null) and has nothing to compare: it authors no frames.

passives.name: Tailor-Made
_curatorNotes: Tailoring as an `infuse` (2026-09-17, T1.5). gcsim asc.go a1Tailoring: AddWeaponInfuse Geo on Normal/Charged/Plunge for a1GeoInfusionDuration = 300f. It is the branch you get by pressing Normal Attack inside the window AND the default when the window lapses (tap: opens 26f, lasts 78f; hold: 42f / 77f) — so it is what ordinary play produces. The note this replaces called the whole passive unmodellable, which is why it stayed blank.

⚠️ The window opens at the cast. In game it opens at the Normal Attack that triggers it, or at the lapse (104f after a tap, 119f after a hold), so its end is drawn up to 1.7s early. Tapestry (E pressed again: a forced swap and Seize the Moment) is not modelled.
passives.description:
Gain different effects depending on the next action you take within a short duration after using Fluttering Hasode's upward sweep. If you Press the Elemental Skill, you will trigger the Tapestry effect. If you Press your Normal Attack, the Tailoring effect will be triggered instead.

Tapestry
· Switches to the next character in your roster.
· Grants all your party members "Seize the Moment": When your active party member's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks hit a nearby opponent, "Tamoto" will execute a coordinated attack, dealing 100% of Fluttering Hasode's upward sweep DMG as AoE Geo DMG at the opponent's location. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
· "Seize the Moment" lasts 8s, and 1 of "Tamoto"'s coordinated attack can be unleashed every 2s. 2 such coordinated attacks can occur per "Seize the Moment" effect duration.

Tailoring
· Chiori gains Geo infusion for 5s.

When on the field, if Chiori does not either Press her Elemental Skill or use a Normal Attack within a short time after using Fluttering Hasode's upward sweep, the Tailoring effect will be triggered by default.

passives.name: The Finishing Touch
_curatorNotes: The C1 branch only (2026-09-17, T1.5; was a `manual` skeleton that drew nothing). gcsim skill.go handleSkill: at C1 with another Geo party member (c1Active), the doll spawn at skillCDStarts creates the rock doll AND calls applyA4Buff — a 20s +20% Geo DMG on Chiori. teamElementCount counts non-holder members, so `geo >= 1` is 'a Geo party member other than Chiori'.

⏸️ The general branch — 'when a nearby party member creates a Geo Construct' (gcsim OnConstructSpawned) — is not authored: no trigger listens to a construct spawn. Adding one needs the construct classifier and corpus tagging this entry's earlier note describes.
passives.description: When a nearby party member creates a Geo Construct, Chiori will gain 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 20s.

constellations.name: Six Paths of Sage Silkcraft
_curatorNotes: Tamoto AoE +50%; with another Geo party member, summons an additional Tamoto and triggers The Finishing Touch on cast. The extra-Tamoto behaviour would mean spawning a second summon; not authored as a conditional summon entry because the additional doll is functionally identical to the base (same emission gap, P3).
constellations.description:
The AoE of the automaton doll "Tamoto" summoned by Fluttering Hasode is increased by 50%.
Additionally, if there is a Geo party member other than Chiori, Fluttering Hasode will trigger the following after the dash is completed:
· Summon an additional Tamoto. Only one additional Tamoto can exist at the same time, whether summoned by Chiori this way or through the presence of a Geo Construct.
· Triggers the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch."

constellations.name: In Five Colors Dyed
_curatorNotes: Post-Q Kinu summoner (every 3s for 10s, 170% of Tamoto's DMG, each Kinu leaves after 1 attack or 3s). Authored 2026-09-19 as the burst's constellation-gated 'C2 Kinu' variant - see the notes there for the gcsim cadence (hits at 312 / 492 / 672f from the cast).
constellations.description:
For 10s after using Hiyoku: Twin Blades, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned next to your active character every 3s. Kinu will attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Geo DMG equivalent to 170% of Tamoto's DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Kinu will leave the field after 1 attack or after lasting 3s.

constellations.name: A Tailor's Three Courtesies
_curatorNotes: Kinu spawn on N/C/P hits during Tailor-Made (Seize the Moment / Tailoring) windows, max 3 per window, 15s lockout per trigger. Not modelled — depends on Tailor-Made window state (A1, unmodelled) and Kinu damage emission (P3).
constellations.description:
For 8s after triggering either follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," when your current active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit a nearby opponent, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned near this opponent. You can summon 1 Kinu every 1s in this way, and up to 3 Kinu may be summoned this way during each instance of "Tailor-Made"'s Seize the Moment or Tailoring effect. The above effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made."

constellations.name: Sole Principle Pursuit
_curatorNotes: C6 has two effects: (1) -12s skill CD when Tailor-Made triggers — not modelled (depends on A1 trigger state, not authored), (2) +235% DEF flat damage on Chiori's Normal Attacks — modelled as the buff above. The CD-reduction half is the more impactful gameplay element but requires the Tailor-Made hook.
constellations.description:
After triggering a follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," Chiori's own Fluttering Hasode's CD is decreased by 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made.".
In addition, the DMG dealt by Chiori's own Normal Attacks is increased by an amount equal to 235% of her own DEF.
